basic_details.scholarship_name: École Polytechnique Paris Master's Excellence Scholarship (IP Paris)
basic_details.offering_entity: École Polytechnique & Institut Polytechnique de Paris (IP Paris) Foundation
degree_levels: Master of Science and Technology (MSc&T) / Master of Science (MSc)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Master's programmes in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Cybersecurity, Data Science, and Advanced Computing.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~30 to 40 merit scholarships (tuition waivers and excellence allowances) awarded annually across IP Paris master's programmes
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open international competition; Pakistani STEM applicants secure ~2 to 4 awards annually
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Up to 2 years (M1 + M2 / 120 ECTS credits), subject to achieving first-class academic standing in Year 1

eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: A recognized 4-year Bachelor's degree (16 years education) in Computer Science, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, or Physics from an HEC-recognized university with highest academic honors (minimum 82% aggregate or CGPA 3.60 / 4.00; top 5-10% of class).
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: French Grandes Écoles place exceptional weight on advanced mathematical rigor (calculus, linear algebra, probability, discrete math).
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Advanced background in mathematics, theoretical computer science, algorithms, and programming.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Students in their final undergraduate year can apply conditionally; degree completion required before September.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Research projects, internships, or competitive programming achievements strongly valued.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: IELTS Academic min 6.5, TOEFL iBT min 90, or Cambridge C1. Medium of Instruction letters not accepted.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: None; international master's programmes are taught entirely in English. French language courses provided free on campus.
eligibility_requirements.gender_specific_requirements: None; female candidates in STEM actively encouraged.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Top-ranked international admits considered for IP Paris Excellence Fellowships.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot hold another full external scholarship.

tuition_fee.details: Full tuition waiver covering 100% of École Polytechnique international master's tuition (~EUR 14,000 to EUR 18,000 / year value).

admission_application_fee.details: IP Paris online application fee of EUR 80 paid via credit card.

accommodation.details: On-campus student accommodation at Palaiseau campus guaranteed for international master's students; single studio in student residence averages EUR 450 to 650/month (eligible for French CAF housing subsidy of ~EUR 150-200/month).

monthly_stipend.details: Excellence fellowship provides a living allowance of EUR 750 to EUR 1,000 / month (~EUR 9,000 to 12,000 / year; ~PKR 232,000 to 310,000 / month), comfortably covering living costs in Palaiseau with CAF housing subsidy.

airfare.details: International travel between Pakistan and Paris Charles de Gaulle (CDG) / Orly (ORY) is self-funded.

visa_fee.details: French Long-Stay Student Visa (VLS-TS) fee of EUR 99 plus Campus France Pakistan processing fee (~PKR 25,000).

health_insurance.details: French National Health Insurance (Sécurité Sociale / Assurance Maladie) is 100% free of charge for all international students in France.

food_allowance.details: Subsidized meals at CROUS student restaurants cost only EUR 3.30 per hot meal.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Free access to École Polytechnique Library, compute servers, GPU clusters, and software tools.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Laboratory travel support available for students conducting master's thesis research in IP Paris laboratories.
research_funding_conference_grant.amount: Up to EUR 1,000 per conference presentation

travel_transit_allowance.details: Île-de-France Imagine R student transport pass provides 50% discount on Paris metro, RER, and bus networks.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single elite French Grande École: École Polytechnique (Institut Polytechnique de Paris, Palaiseau, France)
participating_institutions: LIX - Computer Science Laboratory of École Polytechnique
Centre Interdisciplinaire d'Études pour la Défense et la Sécurité (CIEDS)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: France's #1 institution and top 40 globally (QS World #38, THE World #71); historic Grande École that has produced French heads of state, Nobel laureates, and Fields medalists.
available_majors: Master of Science and Technology in Artificial Intelligence & Advanced Visual Computing
Master of Science and Technology in Cybersecurity: Threats and Defenses
Master of Science and Technology in Data Science for Business

IP Paris Master in Computer Science: High Performance Data Analytics
IP Paris Master in Computer Science: Networks & Distributed Systems
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: 4-year BS in CS/Math/STEM with 3.6+ GPA, strong mathematical foundations, 2 recommendation letters, CV, statement of purpose, and IELTS 6.5+ or TOEFL 90+.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: AI and Data Science attract intense global competition; Foundations of Computer Science and Networks/Distributed Systems offer slightly higher acceptance rates for candidates with strong mathematical rigor.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: École Polytechnique places heavy emphasis on mathematical proficiency; highlight your grades in advanced mathematics, proofs, and theoretical computer science in your dossier.

application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the IP Paris portal, select École Polytechnique as host school, choose your Master's programme, upload required documents, and register 2 academic referees.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1 (October - December): Review programme curricula on the IP Paris website; verify mathematics and programming prerequisites.
Step 2 (November - January): Prepare statement of purpose, CV, transcripts, and secure agreement from 2 academic referees.
Step 3 (Early January - Mid February): Complete online application on the IP Paris application portal.
Step 4 (In application): Select scholarship interest checkbox to be evaluated for excellence funding.
Step 5 (By deadline): Pay the EUR 80 application fee and submit all documents.
Step 6 (February - March): Referees submit letters; admissions committee reviews dossiers.
Step 7 (Late March - Mid April): Admission and scholarship decisions communicated by email.
Step 8 (April - June): Confirm acceptance, pay deposit (if applicable, waived for full scholars), and initiate Campus France Pakistan visa procedure.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated automatic consideration: All applicants are automatically considered for merit scholarships during the regular admission process; no separate application required.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Two academic recommendation letters submitted online via automated referee portal links.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Statement of purpose (1-2 pages) explaining academic background, motivation for choosing École Polytechnique, mathematical and technical preparation, and career ambitions.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Not required at Master's level; concise research interests outline integrated into statement of purpose.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: 1 to 2 page academic CV detailing education, programming proficiencies, mathematical background, and distinctions.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Shortlisted applicants may be invited to a 20-30 minute virtual interview evaluating technical problem solving and motivation.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS Academic (6.5+) or TOEFL iBT (90+). GRE is optional.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Certified copies of degree and transcripts uploaded; verified documents required upon accepting offer.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Official English or French translation required for non-English credentials.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: 100% digital submission via the IP Paris application portal.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Scanned color copy of original Bachelor's degree certificate and official English or French translation.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Pakistani applicants submit 4-year BS degree; HEC attestation recommended.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Complete consolidated semester transcripts detailing all completed course units, grades, and grading scale.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Ensure transcript clearly states credit hours and grading scale (CGPA out of 4.0).

required_documents_checklist.specification: 1-2 page essay articulating academic background, mathematical foundations, and alignment with target master's programme.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Focus on mathematical preparation and technical depth rather than generic background.

required_documents_checklist.specification: 1 to 2 page CV detailing academic background, programming proficiencies, capstone projects, and distinctions.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Highlight final-year project (FYP), math olympiads, and software engineering tools.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Two academic reference letters from professors assessing applicant's analytical rigor and intellectual capability.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Referees must submit from institutional email addresses (.edu.pk).

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official IELTS Academic TRF (6.5+) or TOEFL iBT score report (90+).
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Must be valid through application deadline; MOI letters not accepted.

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Main scholarship round closes in mid-February. Round 2 (April) has very limited scholarship funding.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 55% (Academic excellence, CGPA, mathematical foundations, analytical rigor)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 10% (Clarity of motivation and understanding of IP Paris academic culture)
selection_process_and_weights.interview_weight: Qualifying factor (virtual interview for shortlisted candidates)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: École Polytechnique Graduate Admissions Board and IP Paris Foundation Scholarship Committee.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Faculty jury assessment: Dossiers are evaluated by academic juries focusing heavily on mathematics and computer science depth. Top-ranked admits are awarded tuition waivers and monthly excellence allowances.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: 2,200+ international applicants across IP Paris Master's programmes
competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~30 to 40 full merit scholarships awarded annually
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~2% to 3% among qualified Pakistani STEM applicants
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Undergraduate degree in CS/Math/EE from top Pakistani institution (LUMS, NUST, FAST, GIKI), near-perfect mathematics grades, strong analytical skills, IELTS 7.5+.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates of LUMS, NUST, FAST-NUCES, and GIKI.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: China, India, Lebanon, Pakistan, Brazil, United States, Italy

fake_websites_and_scams: Commercial education recruiters charging placement fees claiming guaranteed admission to École Polytechnique. Admissions are strictly merit-based via ip-paris.fr.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: IP Paris application fee is EUR 80 paid directly online. Never pay fees to external agents.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: École Polytechnique does not work with recruitment agents. Plagiarized statements of purpose result in immediate rejection.
hidden_costs_breakdown: French visa and Campus France fee: ~PKR 55,000.
Flight ticket from Pakistan to Paris: ~PKR 250,000 to 380,000.
First month's rent deposit on campus: ~EUR 500 (~PKR 155,000).
misleading_claims_debunked: CLAIM: French language proficiency is required. (FACT: 100% of courses in international master's programmes are taught in English).
CLAIM: Health insurance costs hundreds of euros. (FACT: French national health insurance is 100% free for all students).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Some student forums confuse the Master of Science (MSc&T) with the historic Ingénieur Polytechnicien cycle. The MSc&T is a 2-year English-taught graduate degree open directly to international bachelor's degree holders.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain satisfactory academic performance (minimum grade average of 12/20 on French grading scale) to renew scholarship for Year 2.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical presence on Palaiseau campus.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Annual progress reviews conducted by the academic program director.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: French student visa permits up to 964 hours of work per year (approx. 20 hours/week), though demanding curriculum requires primary study focus.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None. International graduates qualify for a 1-year post-study job seeker visa (RECE - Recherche d'emploi ou création d'entreprise) in France.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: No clawback of previously awarded funds; academic failure results in cancellation of scholarship for subsequent terms.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Changing programme requires formal application during the next admission cycle.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Scholarship is granted for the nominal 2-year duration (120 ECTS) and cannot be extended.
